metadata.article: ARTICLE 2-1. ZONING DISTRICTS AND LOT AND BUILDING STANDARDS
metadata.division: DIVISION 2-1-10. EXCEPTIONS AND ADJUSTMENTS TO LOT AND BUILDING STANDARDS

content.title: 2-1-10-1. Exceptions to setback standards.
content.summary:
The structures and features enumerated in Table 2-1-10-1, Permitted Encroachments into Required Setbacks, may encroach into required setbacks as provided in the table.
(Ord. No. 4793, § 1, 3-21-2022; Ord. No. 4905, § 12, 8-19-2025)
